title: Escalation view information architecture
summary: Decision-ready information architecture for escalated task details. It assigns the actual blocker to the escalation header, removes duplicate escalation outcome surfaces from Pipeline and Result, preserves the failed-step ATTENTION marker, and flattens Goal and Where it stopped into sibling Result rows with a calm red stopped-state tint. [Curation 2026-08-21 (AGT-2671): reassigned from AGT-W36 to AGT-W40 - that key collided with docs/operations/batch-gate-concept, which claimed it first (created 2026-08-11T23:49:30+02:00, half an hour before this dossier). A duplicated key makes the catalogue reader mark both Dossiers invalid (WorkbenchCatalogueService duplicate-key check), so the collision was a live rendering bug, not a cosmetic one.]
